props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component's state. Extra classes, merged after the area's own. Give the area a height, such as `h-72`, or a max height, such as `max-h-72`. Under a max height, short content keeps the area at its content height, and longer content scrolls once it reaches the cap.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which single scrollbar `Root` renders, and so which axis the content scrolls on. A vertical area holds its content to the viewport's width, so `truncate` text ellipsizes at the edge. A horizontal area lets its content grow to its widest line and scroll. For two-axis scrolling, compose Base UI's `ScrollArea` parts and mount two `ScrollArea.Bar`s, one per orientation.
